hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal has escalated his campaign for the November 29 elections, announcing plans for aggressive legal action against the government for 'selling out Spain' to Carles Puigdemont. The party continues to anchor its campaign platform in hardline anti-immigration policies, demanding mass deportations and national priority for housing and public assistance.
hotspots.affect: Commands disproportionate focus due to fierce framing of national betrayal against the ruling left-wing coalition combined with urgent remigration rhetoric.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei has reinforced his 2027 reelection stance while rejecting public complaints about cost-of-living struggles as 'lies' and ruling out any populist spending plans. The administration posted a viral GTA-inspired video featuring Milei using a chainsaw against political enemies, while he publicly ratified his key alliance with Security Minister Patricia Bullrich.
hotspots.affect: Commands high attention through provocative pop-culture messaging and defiant dismissal of economic hardship claims.

hotspots.title: Moraes Bars Allied Visits to Imprisoned Bolsonaro
hotspots.blurb: Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has imposed strict security limits on visits to Jair Bolsonaro at his residence. Simultaneously, Brazil's Prosecutor General (PGR) formally indicted Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for criminal defamation against President Lula, escalating factional tensions and succession battles inside the Liberal Party.
hotspots.affect: Generates strong affective investment through anti-lawfare grievances against the judiciary and escalating panic over party leadership succession.

hotspots.title: Kaczyński Demands Strict Terms for Constitutional Reset
hotspots.blurb: PiS chairman Jarosław Kaczyński has precipitated a fierce legal and political clash in Poland by setting unyielding conditions for a reset of the Constitutional Tribunal. Kaczyński explicitly ruled out any amnesty for political foes while demanding an overhaul of the Tusk government, drawing an immediate, sharp rejection from Prime Minister Donald Tusk.
hotspots.affect: Drives disproportionate engagement through high-stakes constitutional confrontation and existential disputes over institutional legitimacy.

hotspots.title: AfD Pushes Early Premier Vote in Saxony-Anhalt
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) has triggered significant political alarm in Saxony-Anhalt by trying to force an early vote on December 8 to elect Ulrich Siegmund as Minister-President. The unexpected power play has outraged mainstream parties, who accuse the AfD of attempting to force a state constitutional crisis.
hotspots.affect: Commands intense coverage due to hard-right institutional disruption and establishment anxiety over state-level governance power shifts.
